name: Mine support timbers
description: A mine tunnel set: two barked pine props splayed a little at the foot on flat sill blocks, carrying a squared cap beam with pale wedges driven in over each prop head, iron dogs at the joints and split lagging boards across the top; a coil of rope hangs from a spike on one prop.

provenance.prompt: mine_support_timber: a timber portal of two props and a cap beam with wedges, about 2.2 × 0.4 × 2.4 m (plan 3, item 8).
